name: רִיבַי
summary: The father of Ittai (Ithai) of Gibeah of Benjamin, one of David's mighty men (2Sa 23:29; 1Ch 11:31). The name is the noun רִיב or the verb with the ending ־ַי found in short names such as Jeribai; it may be a shortened form of a name like Joiarib, “Yahweh contends”, but scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Ittai son of Ribai (רִיבַי) from Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin.”
“Yahweh … plead my cause (וְיָרֵב אֶת־רִיבִי)”: the root's sense.

note: Takes t.cm.ac (2 tokens). The ending ־ַי is read as a hypocoristic ending, as in Jeribai and Bezai; the reading “my strife” (רִיבִי) would need different pointing and is not followed. No cognate bears on the name.
